app.name: Finance Tracker
app.tagline: Your finances, on your own server.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check that you are connected to Tailscale.
errors.passwordShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invite is not valid or has expired. Ask the owner for a new one.

login.title: Sign in
login.privateNote: Private app. New accounts by invite only.

twofa.title: Verification code
twofa.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: You are creating the owner account. After this, registration closes and new users join by invite only.
setup.investingBody: Optional. Adds a watchlist, end-of-day prices from free providers and a ranking by past-performance criteria. While it is off, the app makes no calls to market-data providers.
setup.investingLater: You can change this later in Settings.

invite.title: Create your account
invite.intro: You have been invited to this app. Your data stays separate from every other user.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.notificationsBody: A 21:00 reminder to log today's spending, a monthly summary on the 1st, and alerts before subscriptions renew.
onboarding.notificationsEnabled: Notifications are on for this device.
onboarding.notificationsDenied: The browser blocked notifications. You will still see them inside the app.
onboarding.notificationsUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. You will see them inside the app.
onboarding.notificationsNotConfigured: The server has no VAPID keys yet. You will see notifications inside the app.
onboarding.iosHint: On iPhone, notifications work only after you add the app to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later): Share → Add to Home Screen.
onboarding.incomeTitle: Where does your money come from?
onboarding.incomeBody: Add your income sources. Fixed ones create expected payments every month.
onboarding.categoriesBody: You start with Greek defaults. Mark which are essential; you can change them later.
onboarding.accountsTitle: Where do you keep your money?
onboarding.accountsBody: Pick the accounts you want to track.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.emptyBody: Add an expense with the “New expense” button. Fixed income and fixed costs appear here as stations on the line: hollow while expected, filled once received or paid.
dashboard.noBudgets: You have not set any budgets.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.twofaOff: Off. Add a code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
settings.twofaScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand.
settings.monthlyHint: Last month's report and this month's income.
settings.investingHint: Watchlist and ranking by past-performance criteria. Educational, not financial advice.
settings.invitesHint: Each invite works for 7 days and one account.
settings.inviteLink: The link is shown only once. Send it privately.
settings.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Try again.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: Cannot reach the server. You can still log expenses; they are sent when the connection returns.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date.
errors.errorBody: The page did not load. Your data was not affected.

disclaimers.tax: Estimate, not tax advice; confirm with an accountant.
disclaimers.investing: Ranked by past-performance criteria; past performance does not predict future results; educational, not financial advice.

notifications.backupFailedBody: The “{kind}” job failed. See Settings → Backups.
notifications.backupStaleBody: No successful backup in the last {hours} hours.
notifications.dailyBody: A minute to log what you spent today.
notifications.monthlyBody: See how last month went and confirm this month’s income.
notifications.monthlyBodyInvesting: See how last month went, confirm this month’s income and see the monthly investing suggestion.
notifications.unread: {count, plural, one {# new notification} other {# new notifications}}
notifications.digestBody: Top-ranked by past-performance criteria: {symbols}. Data as of {date}. Educational, not financial advice.
notifications.digestBodyEmpty: No instrument has enough price history to rank yet. Data as of {date}.

incomeType.recurring_fixedHint: Salary or fixed pay; creates expected payments.
incomeType.recurring_variableHint: Pay per job, such as ergosimo.

quickAdd.title: New expense
quickAdd.savedOffline: Saved on this device; it is sent when the connection returns.
quickAdd.pending: {count, plural, one {# expense waiting for a connection} other {# expenses waiting for a connection}}

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.emptyHint: Add an expense with the “New expense” button.
transactions.generatedNote: From a recurring item; deleting skips it for this date only.

income.title: Income
income.freelanceHint: Used by the tax and EFKA estimate.
income.noSourcesHint: Add your salary and your irregular pay.
income.scheduleNeeded: A fixed income needs a schedule and an amount.

fixed.title: Fixed costs
fixed.emptyHint: Add rent, bills and subscriptions; they appear on the calendar.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.emptyHint: Add your checking account and your cash.
accounts.taxReserveHint: VAT, tax and EFKA set-asides move here virtually.

categories.title: Categories
categories.essentialHint: Counts as an essential in the Smart Plan.
categories.nameTaken: A category with this name already exists.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.nothingHint: Fixed income and fixed costs appear here automatically.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.intro: A monthly limit overall and per category. You are alerted at {thresholds} of a limit.

monthly.title: Month start
monthly.incomeHint: Confirm what arrived and add irregular pay.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.emergencyHint: The Smart Plan fills it first.
goals.emptyHint: Start with an emergency fund; the Smart Plan fills it first.

plan.title: Smart Plan
plan.disclaimer: Educational, not financial advice. This plan applies general rules of thumb to the numbers you entered. It is an estimate, not a prediction, and not a recommendation to buy or sell anything.
plan.split: How this month’s baseline is split
plan.modeSqueeze: Tight month: a minimum saving is protected and discretionary, then investing, are cut first.
plan.modeDeficit: Your essentials ({essentials}) are {shortfall} above your baseline ({baseline}). Review fixed costs or income.
plan.gateClosed: Investing starts when the emergency fund reaches {months} months of essentials. Until then {amount} goes to savings.
plan.variableBaseline: Variable baseline: the lowest of the last {count} months
plan.oneTimeNote: One-time income (invoices) is not in the baseline; it is routed as surplus.
plan.essentialsFormula: Essentials = fixed essential costs + max(3-month average, budget) per essential category
plan.efProfileFixed: Fixed income: target {months} months of essentials.
plan.efProfileIrregular: Irregular income ({share} % of 6 months’ income): target {months} months of essentials.
plan.efMonths: About {count} months at the current amount.
plan.efRule: Rule of thumb of 3 to 6 months of essentials; the right amount depends on your situation.
plan.efMissing: There is no emergency fund goal; the plan cannot record it.
plan.shortfallLine: Still missing to reach the baseline
plan.overrideHint: Savings is always the balance, so the total is 100 %.
plan.gate: Invest before the emergency fund is full
plan.decisions: Design decisions without a numeric source: the lowest month as baseline, 3 months for essentials, a 25 % threshold for the irregular profile, 30/10/5/10 % shares, a 3-month investing gate, the surplus order.
plan.noIncome: Add income to see a plan.
plan.order: Baseline {baseline} − essentials {essentials} = remainder {remainder}. From the remainder: discretionary {discretionary}, investing {investing}, savings the balance {savings}.
plan.warnProvisional: The baseline rests on fewer than 3 months of variable income, so treat it as provisional.
plan.warnZeroMonth: {month} had no variable income. It counts as 0 and lowers the baseline.
plan.debtHint: If you carry high-interest debt, such as a credit card balance, paying it off may come before investing.
plan.fixAtRisk: Raise the savings share, move the deadline or lower the target.
plan.fixPassed: Set a new deadline or lower the target.
plan.noGoals: No goals apart from the emergency fund.
plan.efDone: The fund has reached its target.
plan.efNotGrowing: At this month’s amount the fund does not grow.
plan.efGoalTarget: The amount set on the goal applies.
plan.efCreate: Create it on the goals page
plan.surplusOrder: Order: tax reserve, free spending, emergency fund, goals, investing.
plan.applyHint: Adds this month’s amounts to the goals as contributions. Running it again updates them.

investing.title: Investing
investing.fxAsOf: EUR at the ECB rate of {date}
investing.fxNone: No ECB rate yet: prices stay in their trading currency
investing.staleCount: {count, plural, one {# quote is stale} other {# quotes are stale}}
investing.whyIntro: Each figure becomes a percentile within your watchlist (100 = highest in the list; for volatility, fall and cost, 100 = lowest). The score is the weighted mean of the percentiles that have data.
investing.insufficientRow: {points} of 252 trading days. It joins the ranking once at least half of the weight has data.
investing.emptyBody: Add instruments in the watchlist to see them ranked.
investing.noPricesBody: With a provider key in .env, prices arrive with the daily refresh at 07:30 Athens time, after the US close. Without one, enter prices by hand in the watchlist.
investing.statusHint: Free tiers only. Requests carry ticker symbols and dates, nothing about you. Budgets stay at 80 % of each free limit.
investing.noKeys: No provider key is set, so prices come only from manual entry. docs/MARKET-DATA.md explains how to add free keys.
investing.fxSource: Exchange rates: ECB reference rates through Frankfurter.
investing.lastError: No provider had a current price on the last attempt.
investing.euNote: May not be available to EU retail investors; check your broker.

suggestion.fromPlan: From the Smart Plan: {pct} % of the baseline of {baseline}.
suggestion.zero: The Smart Plan sets no investing amount this month, so there is nothing to split.
suggestion.held: {amount} is held back until the emergency fund is large enough.

profileSource.default: cautious default until you answer the questionnaire

suggestion.rules: Top {n} ranked instruments, at least {core} % to broad-market ETFs (core), at most {inst} % per instrument, {region} % per region and {currency} % per currency.
suggestion.formula: The core share goes first, split by score; the rest goes to the other instruments by score. Any amount above a limit moves to the next instrument with room. Cents are rounded down and the rest goes in rank order.

notes.no_core: No core instrument is eligible, so the core share goes to the others.
notes.no_other: Only core instruments are eligible, so they take the whole amount.
notes.core_short: The limits kept the core share below its minimum.
notes.caps_reached: The limits leave part of the amount unplaced. Raise a limit, or add instruments in other regions or currencies.
notes.nothing_eligible: No instrument has enough price history yet, so nothing can be split.

watchlist.warnLarge: More than 30 instruments may not fit the free daily call budgets.
watchlist.starterNote: It starts with an educational list you can edit. The list is not a recommendation.
watchlist.domicileHint: Two-letter country code, for example IE or US
watchlist.terHint: Yearly cost from the issuer’s page; leave empty for shares
watchlist.coreHint: A broad-market ETF that can take the core share of the split
watchlist.providerHint: Only if a provider lists this instrument under another symbol, for example IWDA.AS on EODHD.
watchlist.manualHint: The closing price in {currency} on that day. It is used where no provider has a price.
watchlist.invalidPrice: Enter a price above zero, for example 104.25
watchlist.fixedListing: Ticker and exchange identify the price history, so they cannot change. Remove and add the instrument to change them.
watchlist.exists: This listing is already on the watchlist.
watchlist.limit: The watchlist holds at most 40 instruments.

profile.intro: Three questions set how many instruments the monthly split uses and how much of it goes to broad-market ETFs.

q.horizon: When might you need this money?
q.drawdown: If your investments fell 20 % in a year, what would you do?
q.experience: How long have you been investing?

drawdown.keep: Keep the plan as it is
drawdown.continue: Keep going, maybe a little more

profile.shortRule: A horizon under 3 years always gives the conservative profile.
profile.weightsHint: How much each figure counts in the score, 0 to 100. 0 leaves it out.
profile.title: Profile used for the split

tax.title: Tax & EFKA
tax.fallback: No reviewed rates exist for {year} yet; the {configYear} rates are used [uncertain].
tax.noFreelanceBody: Mark an income source as freelance (Income → source → Freelance invoices) and record what you receive; each payment counts as an invoice net of VAT.
tax.now: To move to the tax reserve now
tax.nowHint: Estimated VAT, income tax and EFKA from January to today (EFKA up to the last month that ended), minus what you have already moved.
tax.noReserve: No tax reserve account yet; the first move creates one.
tax.prepayment: Prepayment for next year (cash with the return)
tax.prepaymentHint: Not extra tax: it is credited against next year’s tax.
tax.withheld: Withheld by clients (credited at year end)
tax.crossing: This invoice crosses the €10,000 small-business limit: VAT applies to it in full and to every later invoice this year. A declaration of changes is due within 30 days.
tax.formula: Each invoice reserves the extra income tax it causes on top of your other income: tax(other income + business profit so far) − tax(other income). EFKA is a monthly cost; it lowers business profit, which releases a little of the income tax. VAT is the invoice net × the VAT rate.
tax.profileHint: These numbers drive the estimate. Change them when your situation changes.
tax.employment: Other annual taxable income (salary, pension, εργόσημο)
tax.employmentHint: Your estimate for the whole year; your business profit stacks on top of it.
tax.insuranceStartHint: The special class ends after 5 years.
tax.parallel: I also have a salaried job
tax.parallelHint: The main contribution never goes below class 2 (class 1 for new professionals), minus what the job pays [uncertain].
tax.salariedContributions: Monthly contributions paid through the job
tax.extrasCovered: Unemployment and other extras are paid through the job
tax.previousTurnover: Greek turnover last year, without VAT
tax.firstTime: First year I declare business income (halves the prepayment)
tax.clientsWithhold: My clients withhold 20 % on fees above €300
tax.bandCut: New sole proprietor: halve the first-band rate (first 3 years, gross up to €10,000) [uncertain]
tax.minimum: Minimum presumed income (leave empty if it does not apply) [uncertain]
tax.ratesHint: Every rate comes from this table, with its source and the date it was last reviewed. You can correct a value; the change applies only to your estimate.
uncertain: How the employment tax reduction (art. 16) is shared when you also have business income: the estimate prorates it by the employment share.
Which salaried contributions reduce EFKA when you also have a job, and the exact floors (class 2, or class 1 for new professionals).
Whether the prepayment takes a proportional or a marginal share of the tax; the estimate uses the proportional share.
The legal due date of the monthly EFKA payment (assumed: last working day of the next month).
Whether your books are simplified (quarterly VAT) or double-entry (monthly VAT).
Whether services to clients in other EU countries count toward the €10,000 small-business limit.
Which services carry the 20 % withholding, and the 2026 return and instalment dates (not published yet).
Not modelled: tax credits, other deductions, presumed living costs, losses carried forward.

reports.title: Reports
reports.historyEmpty: No month has closed since you started. The first report appears on the 1st of next month.
reports.snapshotNote: A report is a snapshot of the month when it closed; later edits do not change it.
reports.noPrevious: No data for the month before.
reports.noRenewals: No fixed costs or renewals expected.
reports.taxEstimated: Estimated set-aside for the year to the end of the month
reports.taxBalance: In the tax reserve at month end
